description: Issue 4 (P2): add the isolated Prisma default-behavior integration test at backend/src/tests/integration/liveclass-microphone-default.integration.test.js with the four cases from the design (Prisma create omitting the field; Prisma create explicit; raw SQL INSERT omitting the column; raw SQL INSERT explicit). Follows the self-contained PrismaClient pattern of liveclass-microphone-triggers.integration.test.js. The test must be registered in the destructive list of the test-safety manifest in the same commit.
steps: Read .agents/pipeline/2026-11-21_00-53-25/02-design.md section 'Issue 4' — it contains the complete test file code (beforeAll fixtures, four test cases, afterAll cleanup). Transcribe it into backend/src/tests/integration/liveclass-microphone-default.integration.test.js, using the design's exact fixtures: school with name 'mic-default-test-school-<uid>', slug 'mic-default-<uid>', country 'MY'; teacher with firstName 'MicDefault', lastName 'Teacher', email 'mic-default-teacher-<uid>@test.local', passwordHash 'hashed-not-real', role 'TEACHER', status 'ACTIVE', emailVerified true; const { v4: uuidv4 } = require('uuid') at module scope.

Case 1: a second PrismaClient with log: [{ emit: 'event', level: 'query' }] created inside the test; capture { query: e.query, params: e.params }; create the live class with microphoneAuthorizationMode omitted; assert lc.microphoneAuthorizationMode === 'SFU_AUTHORITATIVE'; find the INSERT event (query contains 'insert' and 'live_classes'); assert insertEvent.params (a JSON string in Prisma 5.x) contains 'SFU_AUTHORITATIVE'; read back via prisma.$queryRawUnsafe on the outer client and assert SFU_AUTHORITATIVE; disconnect the logging client; push the id into createdLcIds.
Case 2: create with microphoneAuthorizationMode: 'SFU_AUTHORITATIVE'; assert ORM return + raw read-back are SFU_AUTHORITATIVE.

Case 3: raw SQL INSERT omitting the column (the design's exact INSERT with 16 ? params); derive expectedDefault by querying _prisma_migrations for a finished migration matching '%reconcile_microphone_authorization_default%' (SFU_AUTHORITATIVE if present, LEGACY otherwise — with only current migrations applied it is LEGACY); assert the stored value equals expectedDefault; secondary confirmation via SHOW COLUMNS FROM live_classes LIKE 'microphone_authorization_mode' with colInfo[0].Default === expectedDefault.
Case 4: raw SQL INSERT with explicit microphone_authorization_mode 'SFU_AUTHORITATIVE'; assert stored value SFU_AUTHORITATIVE.
afterAll: delete all createdLcIds rows first, then teacher, then school (each .catch(() => {})), then prisma.$disconnect().

CRITICAL — register the file in backend/test-safety/safe-test-manifest.js: add 'src/tests/integration/liveclass-microphone-default.integration.test.js' to DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS in alphabetical position (between 'src/tests/integration/live-class.integration.test.js' and 'src/tests/integration/liveclass-microphone-triggers.integration.test.js'). The manifest audit (auditClassification) throws 'unclassified test file' otherwise and breaks every unit run.
Commit with message 'test(live-class): add Prisma default-behavior integration test (Issue 4)'.
acceptance_criteria: The new test file exists and contains exactly the four cases; Cases 1, 2, 4 assert SFU_AUTHORITATIVE deterministically.
Case 1 asserts the client-side default via e.params containing 'SFU_AUTHORITATIVE' (not via the DB default).
Case 3's expectation is derived from the applied migration state (not tautologically from SHOW COLUMNS).
Cleanup deletes only rows created by the test (createdLcIds) and their fixtures, in FK-safe order.
The file is listed in DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS in safe-test-manifest.js, and npm run test:unit still runs.
The test passes against the migrated halqa_test database, and passes again unchanged on a second run (deterministic).
verification: cd backend; npm run test:unit — the manifest audit passes (no 'unclassified test file' error) and the safe suite is green.

Ensure the disposable DB exists and is migrated (see FEAT-003 verification steps; if not yet done: create halqa_test, then $env:DATABASE_URL='mysql://root@localhost:3306/halqa_test'; npx prisma migrate deploy).

cd backend; $env:DATABASE_URL='mysql://root@localhost:3306/halqa_test'; $env:NODE_ENV='test'; $env:JWT_SECRET='ci_integration_jwt_secret_at_least_32_characters!!'; $env:JWT_REFRESH_SECRET='ci_integration_refresh_secret_32_chars!!'; $env:PORT='5002'; npm run test:integration -- src/tests/integration/liveclass-microphone-default.integration.test.js — 4/4 pass, Case 3 expects LEGACY at this stage (reconciliation migration not yet present).
Run the same command a second time — still 4/4 (no cleanup needed between runs).
